newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Danube still closed, crew missing after boat crash.
newsitem.headline: Danube still closed, crew missing after boat crash.

text.p: The Danube remained closed in Vienna on Thursday and eight Slovak crewmen were still missing and presumed dead after a boat accident two days earlier heavily damaged a weir, river police said.
The accident blocked all commercial shipping traffic on Europe's busiest east-west waterway after a boat disappeared in the swollen river late on Tuesday.
Emergency crews rescued only one badly injured man and the search for the missing as well as their boat was still under way, river police said.
"The search is still going on," a spokesman told Reuters. "It's a pretty difficult job."

He said the 35-metre (115-foot) boat, which had been pushing a barge loaded with 750 tonnes fishmeal, was submerged somewhere on the riverbed downstream from the weir through which it was forced by the current after crashing into the flood gates.
River police confirmed initial forecasts that the Danube would probably remain closed to all commercial traffic for several days, causing hold-ups at ports around Vienna.
